messages:
Noah (AE): Heads-up: Aurelia Care wants to POC ember-13b-rlhf-med-v1. They need: hosted vs dedicated options, 12k context perf, and confirmation we can onboard into catalog (variants + rollbacks).
Noah (AE): They also attached an SQA and a short eval suite.
Priya Singh (SE): Can someone grab the model manifest + sample eval prompts? Also want to know tokenizer (they said "sentencepiece-ember" but need exact vocab).
Ethan Chu: I'll take runtime compatibility. Planned quick checks: tokenization, kv cache layout, quant format (nf4 / qlora?), and any custom attention ops.
Priya Singh (SE): Quick checklist for the thread:
- tokenizer exact artifact name
- rotary/rope params
- quant format + group size
- fused kernels (flash attention) used?
- expected avg response length for their chat flows

Ethan Chu: Model manifest: model_id: aurelia/ember-13b-rlhf-med-v1, weights: gs://aurelia-models/ember13/nf4-weights.bin, tokenizer: sentencepiece-ember-32000. They confirmed NF4 quant.
Dara Khan: License note: model is under "research-use-only" with commercial restrictions. Security flagged this in the SQA; we need to call out deployment constraints.
Ethan Chu: Running lint + smoke now. Command:
```bash
rdx-cli inspect --model gs://aurelia-models/ember13/nf4-weights.bin --out /tmp/inspect.json
rdx-runtime --model /tmp/ember13 --max-seq 12288 --batch 6 --dry-run
```

Ethan Chu: Results: tokenizer loads, vocab=32000. kv cache layout = standard contiguous KV. NF4 metadata present with group_size=64. Attention uses standard causal + rotary with base 10000. No custom fused ops in the checkpoints.
Ethan Chu: Caveat: our NF4 fast path is experimental; fallback path dequantizes to 16-bit internally -> performance penalty ~1.6x vs a native 8-bit optimized path.
Priya Singh (SE): For the customers expected workload (median 400 tokens per response, 200 concurrent sessions) what does that translate to?
Ethan Chu: Rough ballpark on 1x A100-80GB: steady-state p50 token latency ~12-18ms (with batching), p95 token latency ~28-35ms. For 400 tokens, p95 ~11-14s. To hit sub-1s for 600 tokens (their original ask) is not feasible without a smaller model or heavy pipelining and result streaming.
Noah (AE): I'll set expectations. They specifically asked if we can put ember-13b into our Hosted catalog for a 48-hour smoke. Any license blockers?
Dara Khan: Because it's research-use-only / commercial-restricted, we cannot put the weights on our multi-tenant shared pool. Options:
- Hosted isolated tenant (customer-scoped storage + single-tenant runtime)
- Dedicated (reserved nodes)
- Private (on-prem or VPC)
I'll draft SQA language that says we will not redistribute and will log access.
Priya Singh (SE): Catalog variant/fallback question: they want ember-13b as default but fallback to ember-7b-small if latency/memory thresholds hit. Are tokenizers identical?
Ethan Chu: ember-7b uses a different tokenizer (byte-bpe-ember). That means automatic model-level fallback with identical tokenization isn't possible. We can do routing-level fallback (route to ember-7b) but output will differ and client must accept that behavior. We can also provide a distilled ember-7b recompiled to use sentencepiece-ember if they want engineering effort.
Noah (AE): Good to note for SOW. Also they want A/B canary: 5% traffic to ember-13b, 95% to ember-7b for 24h, then swap based on quality metrics. Is that doable?
Ethan Chu: Yes. Steps: pin ember-13b:v1 in catalog, create ember-7b:compat variant, set routing policy with route percentages, attach eval hooks to run prompt-based quality checks, monitor latency/err rate. Canary orchestration is supported.
Dara Khan: Proposed SQA wording (pasteable): "Redwood will ingest customer-supplied model artifacts into customer-scoped storage and deploy to an isolated tenant for Hosted evaluation. Artifacts will not be redistributed. For Dedicated/Private deployments, artifacts remain under customer control as requested. Access is auditable and hashes are verified prior to ingestion."
Noah (AE): Perfect, I'll include that in the questionnaire response.
infra-bot: Canary job scheduled: canary/ember-13b-v1 -> 1 node (5% traffic) at 2025-04-12T15:00Z.
Priya Singh (SE): Pricing/approx for Dedicated (4x80GB) to support 200 concurrent sessions? Anyone got a quick estimate?
Ethan Chu: Ballpark: reserved infra + infra overhead + support margin -> ~ $XXk/mo (sending detailed calc offline). Main driver is GPU reservation and replication for HA.
Noah (AE): Action items:
- Ethan: confirm NF4 fast-path workarounds and perf tuning ETA (2 business days)
- Priya: collect client eval prompts and expected traffic distribution (ETA EOD)
- Dara: finalize SQA language and return (ETA EOD)
- Noah: update customer with constraints and POC plan (canary + isolated hosted option)

Noah (AE): Thanks all. I'll ping when Aurelia responds to the SOW. :thumbsup:
